# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in Nine, **please do not** open a public issue.

Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting: go to the [Security](https://github.com/djordlucas/nine/security) tab
and click **"Report a vulnerability"**. This creates a private advisory visible only to you and me.

Include as much detail as possible:
- Steps to reproduce the issue
- Impact assessment
- Potential mitigation or fix

I will acknowledge receipt within 48 hours and provide a timeline for a fix.

## Security Updates

Security patches are released as soon as they are ready. Critical fixes may be
backported to previous releases. Subscribe to [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/djordlucas/nine/releases)
for notifications.

## Scope

This policy applies to:
- The Nine source code
- Official Docker images (`ghcr.io/djordlucas/nine`)
- Built-in plugins and tools

## Not In Scope

- Misconfigurations of Nine in your own environment
- Issues in third-party MCP servers or plugins
- Vulnerabilities in dependencies (report to the upstream project)

## Preferred Languages

English or French.
